· MACD histogram trajectory (1.1277 → 0.1682) + worsening trend + weak signal for trend reversal.

[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.66x) + reduced confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation) + conditions for entry: confirmation of RSI recovery above 50 and MACD histogram improvement.
